title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Shopify B2B Companies and Company Locations (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: New B2B capabilities: locations, payment terms, and tax ID
Importing Shopify locations into Business Central
Exporting customer data and tax ID mapping
Catalog sync and company ID traceability
Payment terms and location mapping completion

features.name: Shopify B2B company locations import
features.description: Shopify connector now imports all company locations from Shopify into Business Central, including address information, tax IDs, and payment terms for each location.
caveats: Default location is determined by Shopify connector using the first imported location, as it is not possible to specify default location in Shopify admin

features.name: Tax ID automatic entity mapping
features.description: Tax ID information imported from Shopify can be used for automatic entity mapping to link Shopify companies to Business Central customers based on registration number.

features.name: Customer export with tax ID and company ID
features.description: When exporting customer data from Business Central to Shopify, the connector now includes tax ID and company ID information to improve order creation and traceability.

features.name: Payment terms mapping
features.description: Payment terms can be mapped between Shopify and Business Central, with payment term details transferring to Shopify and stored in the default company location.
caveats: Requires mapping configuration between Shopify payment terms and Business Central payment terms

features.name: Automatic catalog creation with customer-specific pricing
features.description: Shopify connector can automatically create catalogs ensuring prices are equal between Shopify and Business Central, with the customer number field now filled in to calculate prices specific to that customer.
caveats: Requires sync prices toggle to be enabled

features.name: Shopify shop card tax ID mapping field
features.description: New field on Shopify shop card page allows configuration of which tax ID to send to Shopify: either registration number or VAT registration number.

features.name: Company attention field in location
features.description: Shopify connector fills in the company/attention field in the created company location with the company name, which is used in imported orders.
